question: Simplify (7 div(7 times 7))/((7 div 7) times 7)
solution:
**Given:**

Expression:

**Calculation:**

Numerator: 7 ÷ (7 × 7)

⇒ 7 ÷ 49

⇒ 1 / 7

Denominator: (7 ÷ 7) × 7

⇒ 1 × 7

⇒ 7

Now, the expression becomes:

⇒ (1 / 7) ÷ 7

⇒ 1 / 49

**∴ The simplified value of the expression is 1/49.**
